protocol:
1. Place the Invitrogen E-Gel EX 1% agarose gel cassette on the bench with the sample wells exposed, and keep the microcentrifuge/PCR tubes on ice.

2. Using a single-channel adjustable pipette with a fresh tip, pipette prepared liquid from the open microcentrifuge/PCR tubes and mix by aspiration/dispensing in the tube.

3. Load the first prepared sample into a well of the E-Gel EX 1% cassette with the single-channel pipette.

4. Change the pipette tip, prepare the next sample tube, and load the next prepared sample into a separate well of the E-Gel EX 1% cassette.

5. Place the loaded E-Gel EX 1% cassette into the Invitrogen E-Gel Power Snap instrument.

6. Select the E-Gel EX 1% gel type on the E-Gel Power Snap touchscreen.

7. Set the E-Gel Power Snap run time to 10 min and start electrophoresis.
